taurus.horoscope: Your significant other might be facing some challenges with their coworkers today, Taurus. Instead of merely offering comfort, remember that they might not be seeking sympathy. What they really need are practical solutions. If you don’t have any advice to share, simply being a supportive listener can make a difference. Additionally, make sure to prioritize your own well-being by getting some exercise. If the weather permits, enjoy a refreshing walk outside; if not, consider joining an online workout session. You'll find that it lifts your spirits.
